stories.title: Homesage.ai launches return-first property search — find rentals by the yield, not the bedroom count
stories.summary: Homesage.ai launched Investment Property Search on November 10. You search by the return you want, not by price and bedrooms. That means yearly rent as a share of the price, or cash profit as a share of the cash you put in. It returns for-sale homes that meet it, each with an estimated monthly rent.

stories.title: Brokurz lets outside AI agents into the lead system — Grok Bot, Dots, and Muse can read lead briefs
stories.summary: Brokurz AI Assistants came out November 7. It lets assistants like Grok Bot, Dots, or Muse read lead briefs and draft texts inside Brokurz, the system agents use to track leads. Connecting one does not send texts on its own. Everything runs under permissions the user sets — and this comes from a single launch-radar listing, a lead, not a verified launch.

watch.title: Tuccori buyer settlement — STILL no outcome, 9 days post-hearing.
watch.text: A Nov 6 filing shows the judge wants proof the seller settlements are a yardstick for the buyer deals. She wants per-person payouts, each defendant's ability to pay, and what litigation would be worth. Still no approval: $120.3M fund, 132,000+ claims, 25 opt-outs, 2 objections.

watch.title: Compass subpoena fight — cooling off.
watch.text: Compass and the national Realtor group filed a joint deal Nov 9. Compass strategy chief Ashton Alexander sits for a deposition of 5 hours or less, and the group won't subpoena CEO Robert Reffkin. A Nov 10 California order did the same for three Compass agents, and the Nov 20 hearing's status is now in doubt.

watch.title: Zillow steering case — reconsideration denied Nov 10.
watch.text: A Seattle court said no to Zillow's bid to drop the antitrust suit. The suit, filed as Dupuis in January 2026, says Zillow tied its Preferred program to Zillow Home Loans — and the case now proceeds.

watch.title: Moehrl home-seller case — still paused.
watch.text: Objectors to the home-seller settlements say they may ask the Supreme Court to review them. Rehearing requests are all rejected so far. The parties asked the court to keep the pause, and few updates are expected until an appeal is filed.

watch.title: Copyright + data-feed policy — no adopter yet.
watch.text: Approved Nov 8: a local listing system may claim up to a 50% shared copyright interest in listing content, and set its own data-feed rules. No listing system has adopted it yet — watch for the first one.

watch.title: AI photo disclosure — hard deadline Jan 1, 2027 (51 days).
watch.text: Photo disclosure rules take effect Jan 1, 2027 in California and Wisconsin. North Texas fines agents from Feb 1, 2027 who don't show the original with AI-changed photos. In Ontario, the agent must say when AI shaped a listing — and answer for its accuracy.
